abstractEnglish: At the critical honeycomb vertex activity, the squared-length mass of simple polygons of diameter at most H, counted modulo translations, is at most $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$. We also prove a quantitative two-mark cylinder estimate and a polynomial one-arc bound uniform even for arbitrarily unequal marked intervals.
